claim: Every spectral subset of cardinality 14 in Z/2310Z tiles.
arithmetic_correction: 14 divides 210; projected spectrality is a tiling branch, not an impossibility.

imported_results.name: spectral-to-tiling in Z/210Z
imported_results.use: A successfully descended projected pair makes the projection of A tile.

imported_results.name: levelwise cuboid lemma
imported_results.use: A failed Phi_(11d)-to-Phi_d descent makes a cuboid evaluation a nonzero multiple of 11 and forces every 11-level nonempty.

imported_results.name: spectral mask-zero characterization
imported_results.use: Differences in either member force zeros of the opposite mask.

proof_map.statement: Phi_11 is absent because 11 does not divide 14; both projections to Z/210Z are injective.
If either mask satisfies every Phi_(11d)-to-Phi_d implication, the projected pair is spectral; its A-projection tiles Z/210Z, and the graph lift tiles with complement T x Z/11Z.
If both descents fail, both sets meet all eleven levels and have exactly Q, M, or D3 section cardinalities.
Irreducibility of Phi_11 over Q(zeta_d) makes all A-section Fourier sums equal for every difference between representatives of distinct Lambda levels.
A singleton A-section and an r-section, 2<=r<=4, give eleven vectors in C^r with Gram matrix (r-1)I_11+J_11, determinant (r+10)(r-1)^10, and rank 11, impossible in dimension r.

gram_certificate.contradiction: rank 11 exceeds r for r in {2,3,4}

conclusion: The two-failed-descent branch is impossible, so a descent succeeds and A tiles.
